content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves the Isaiah 7:14 link by treating the sign's own wording as decisive on whether it states the mechanism.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "none", "why": "The judge treats the link as underdetermined because the sign verse itself does not state the mechanism, which is the retired verse-by-verse stating test rather than a chain-by-chain weighing by footing."}
